hint.immutable_record: Immutable record of every action taken in the system

hint.cost_admin_only: Cost, profit and margin figures are visible to administrators only.
hint.optional_unique: Optional. Must be unique if provided.

hint.what_you_pay: What you pay. Visible to Administrators only.
hint.free_text_explain: are free text. Start typing to pick an existing one, or enter a new name and it will be created automatically when you save. Matching ignores capitalisation.
hint.stock_not_editable: is not editable here. Stock only changes through restocks, sales and adjustments, so the ledger and the running total can never disagree.
hint.cost_feeds_margin: feeds margin reporting. It is refreshed automatically whenever you record a restock with a unit cost.
hint.threshold_drives_badge: drives the alert badge in the sidebar.
hint.admin_full_access: have full access: user management, financial reports, system settings and record deletion.
hint.manager_scope: handle day-to-day operations — products, sales, customers and debt collection — but cannot see cost prices or profit margins.
hint.applied_oldest: Payment is applied to the oldest debt first.
hint.leave_blank_walk_in: Leave blank for a walk-in cash sale.
hint.optional_photo: Optional. Photograph the paper receipt, bank slip or mobile-money confirmation. Images or PDF, up to 5 MB each.
hint.audit_immutable: Entries here can never be edited or deleted, by anyone, including administrators. Logins, failed login attempts, stock changes, payments, voids and overrides are all captured.
hint.aging_right_of: Anything to the right of "not yet due" is money that should already be in the bank.
hint.cost_snapshot_note: Cost figures are snapshots taken at the time of sale, so historical margins stay accurate.
hint.profit_method_body: Each sale line stores the product's cost at the moment it was sold. Changing a product's cost price today does not rewrite last month's margins — historical profit stays accurate. Voided transactions are excluded throughout. Money still owed on credit is counted as revenue but has not yet been collected; compare against the receivables report.
hint.unrealised_note: Unrealised profit assumes every unit sells at full price with no discount or shrinkage.
hint.ledger_permanent: This payment is written to a permanent ledger. It cannot be edited afterwards — if you make a mistake, an administrator reverses it and the correction stays on record.
hint.allocation_body: the money is allocated to the oldest debt first, then the next, until it runs out. Each debt gets its own ledger entry, so the trail stays clear.
hint.credit_limit_pos: The credit limit is enforced at the point of sale. A sale that would push this customer past the limit is refused before any stock moves, so you never end up with goods gone and no way to record the debt.
hint.reason_permanent: A reason is required. Adjustments are written permanently to the stock ledger against your name and can never be edited or removed.
hint.restock_ledger: This writes a permanent RESTOCK entry to the stock ledger.
hint.unit_cost_updates: Entering a unit cost updates the product's cost price, which feeds margin reporting.
hint.accepted_files: Accepted: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 5 MB. Attach the signed paper receipt, a bank slip, or a mobile-money confirmation.
hint.soft_delete_body: The product is hidden from lists and can no longer be sold, but the record and all its sales history stay intact so past transactions and reports remain accurate. Nothing is physically removed from the database.
hint.password_hashed: The password is stored hashed and cannot be read back.
hint.accounts_never_deleted: Accounts are never deleted, only deactivated.
hint.role_admin_desc: full access. Can manage users, see cost prices and profit margins, void sales, write off debts, set credit limits and change settings.
hint.role_manager_desc: operational access. Records sales, manages products, customers and debt collection. Cannot see cost or margin data, cannot delete or override anything, cannot manage users.
hint.last_admin_guard: the system will not let you demote or deactivate the last remaining active administrator, so you can never lock yourself out.
hint.stock_take_desc: you counted the shelf and it disagrees with the system. Enter the counted total; the difference is recorded.
hint.write_off_desc: goods damaged, expired or lost. Enter the quantity removed.
hint.customer_return_desc: goods came back and are resalable. Enter the quantity returning to the shelf.

help.linked_document: Linked document, e.g. TXN-20260821-0007 or a supplier invoice no.

help.blank_anon: Leave blank for an anonymous cash sale. Required for credit.
help.only_balance: Only used when there is a balance to collect.
help.reschedule_note: Rescheduling changes only when the debt falls due. The amount owed is unchanged — balances can only move through the repayment ledger. The change is recorded in the audit log.
prose.phone_unique_id: The phone number is the customer's unique identifier and must not repeat.
prose.pay_later_approval: A customer can only buy on "Pay Later" terms once an administrator ticks credit approved.
prose.limit_set_borrower: Their credit limit is then set on the borrower profile. A sale that would push them past that limit is refused at the point of sale, before any stock moves.
prose.managers_cannot_approve: Managers can register customers but cannot grant credit approval.

prose.confirm_writeoff: I confirm this debt is uncollectable and accept the loss.
prose.confirm_reversal: I understand this restores the outstanding balance.

sec.title: Registration security
sec.heading: Registration & passcodes
sec.readonly: You can see these settings but not change them. Changing them needs the "Change system settings" permission.
sec.master_switch: The master switch. When this is off, nobody can create their own account no matter which passcodes are set, and new staff can only be added from Users & Roles.
sec.allow_signup: Let new staff sign themselves up with a passcode
sec.per_role_help: Each role has its own code, so somebody handed the sales code can only ever create a sales account. Leave a box empty to keep the code that is already set — codes are stored scrambled and cannot be read back, so an empty box is normal.
sec.from_env: Using the code set on the server. Typing a new one here replaces it.
sec.from_screen: A passcode is set from this screen.
sec.shared: It is shared, so treat it like the shop keys: anyone who learns the administrator code can create an administrator.
sec.audited: Every attempt, right or wrong, is written to the audit log with the address it came from.
sec.not_readable: It cannot be read back. To hand it out again, set a new one.
sec.new_sales_title: What a new sales user gets
sec.new_sales_body: Someone registering with the sales code is asked who they report to. That choice is what gives them products to sell: they see their supervisor's stock, while their own sales, customers and debts stay theirs alone.
sec.new_sales_more: Everything else about them is the Sales role's defaults, which you can change under Roles — or per person under Access Control.
hub.two_questions: Access is two separate questions. Permissions decide what a person may do; data scope decides whose records they may see. A sales user with permission to view sales still only ever sees their own. Both are set per person under Access Control.
hub.access_blurb: Tick exactly what each person may do. Start from their role, then add or remove individual permissions for that one person.
hub.roles_blurb: A role is a named bundle of permissions. Change one and everybody holding it changes with it — except where an individual has been given an exception.
hub.business_blurb: Name, contact details and currency, plus the operational defaults new records start from.
hub.staff_blurb: Accounts, passwords and the permanent record of who did what.
hub.django_warning: The Django admin edits the database directly and skips stock movements, audit entries and balance recalculation. Use it only to recover from something this app cannot fix.
biz.title: Business settings
biz.identity_help: Printed on receipts and shown in the sidebar. Leave a field blank to keep using the value from the server configuration — the grey text in each box shows what that is.
biz.on_server_help: These come from environment variables and cannot be changed here, because getting them wrong from a web form would take the site down.
acc.subtitle: Who may do what, and whose records they see
accf.self_lock: This is your own account. The permissions that keep this page reachable are locked on, so a mistake here cannot lock you out.
role.subtitle: Named bundles of permissions
role.warning: Editing a role changes everyone who holds it. Someone whose access was customised individually keeps their exceptions — a permission they were explicitly given stays given, and one explicitly taken away stays away. To undo an exception, open that person in Access Control.
role.builtin_note: A built-in role. You can change what it grants; you cannot rename its code, switch it off or delete it.
role.safe_to_remove: Nobody holds this role. Safe to remove.
reg.photo_help: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 3 MB. Square images look best.
reg.passcode_note: Each role has its own passcode. You can only create the kind of account you have the code for.
reg.manager_help: Sales staff sell from their supervisor's stock, so this decides which products you will see. Leave blank if you work independently.
dash.blurb_owner: Every sale, every debt and every product in the business, including what the stock cost and what it earns.
dash.blurb_stock: The shelf you control and the people who sell from it. Your own records plus your team's.
dash.blurb_counter: Your counter: what you sold, what your customers owe you, and what you have collected. Nobody else's figures appear here.
dash.blurb_viewer: The records you have been given access to.
dash.no_customers_yet: You have not registered any customers yet.
dash.no_supervisor: You are not attached to a supervisor yet, so you may see no products. Ask an administrator to set who you report to.
scope.own_help: Sees only the sales, customers and debts they created.
scope.team_help: Also sees everything created by the people who report to them.
scope.all_help: No filtering at all. Reserve this for owners.
scope.use_role_own: Use the role's setting (Own records only)
scope.use_role_team: Use the role's setting (Own records and their team's)
scope.use_role_all: Use the role's setting (Everything in the business)
users.starting_point: A role is only the starting point.
users.managers_own: own the products and the stock;
users.sales_own: sell their manager's stock and keep their own customers and debts. Anything can be granted or removed per person from
word.nothing_below_reorder: Nothing is at or below its reorder threshold.
roledesc.admin: The owner. Full control of products, sales, credit, staff and settings, and the only role that sees every record in the business.
roledesc.manager: Controls the products and the stock. Buys in, prices, counts and sells. Sees their own records plus those of the sales staff assigned to them - but not profit margins, staff accounts or system settings.
roledesc.sales: Sells the stock their manager holds. Registers their own customers, can sell on credit under their own name, and collects repayments. Sees only their own sales, customers and debts, and never a cost price.
bizf.currency_help: Shown before every amount, e.g. ETB.
bizf.due_days_help: How long a customer has to settle a credit sale, by default.
bizf.low_stock_help: Suggested reorder level for a new product.
bizf.require_approval_help: Only let a customer buy on credit once someone has explicitly approved them for it. Turning this off lets any registered customer run a balance, which is faster and riskier.
rolef.code_help: Short uppercase identifier used in the database and the API. Cannot be changed once the role exists.
rolef.desc_help: Shown to administrators when picking a role for someone.
rolef.scope_help: OWN: only their own records. TEAM: theirs plus anyone reporting to them. ALL: the whole business.
rolef.rank_help: Sort order in every role list. Lower is more senior.
rolef.builtin_no_off: Built-in roles cannot be switched off.
accf.tick_note: Ticking or unticking a box below records a difference from this role, not a change to it.
accf.manager_help: A sales user needs this: it is the shelf they sell from. Their own sales, customers and debts still belong to them.
accf.scope_blank_help: Leave blank to use the role's scope.
accf.role_help: Ticking or unticking a box below records a difference from this role, not a change to it.
prof.void_writeoff: Void sales and write off debts
prof.photo_hint: Profile photo. Square images look best.
regf.username_help: Used to sign in. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.
regf.role_help: You need the passcode for the role you pick.
regf.passcode_help: Ask the business owner for the code for your role.
sale.credit_note: A debt record will be opened in your name and tracked on the Credit dashboard. A registered, credit-approved customer is required.
